title: Reusable platform services make delivery consistent across processing, interoperability, and operations
intro: UHG should package common capabilities as supported services and approved patterns so teams can deliver quickly without recreating architecture, controls, or operational tooling for every workload
runtime_and_operations_groups: Standard workspace, capacity, OneLake, lakehouse, warehouse, real-time, data engineering, and AI/ML runtime patterns
Defined capacity allocation, workload isolation, lifecycle, performance, availability, and recovery requirements
Capacity and cost estimates tied to workload placement criteria, associated capacity scaling/guardrails
Automated provisioning, GitHub-based CI/CD, code scanning, artifact management, and controlled environment promotion, leveraging existing DevOps toolsets
Integration with existing observability and enablement of application stack logging, monitoring, and tracing capabilities
Guidance on Azure service purchasing and cost impacts
networking_connectivity_group: Approved private connectivity, gateway, endpoint, routing, firewall, and name-resolution patterns
Secure connectivity across Fabric, UDLP, SDRP, operational systems, external sources, and Microsoft services
Standard batch, streaming, API, file, replication, and virtualization paths that minimize unnecessary exposure and data movement
Ingress and egress patterns and associated network security controls
